A genuine nongeneric parent default takes and returns the parent interface type.
Its generic compatibility child forwards an unchanged raw receiver and argument.
No method Signature or generic result binding is needed. The selected method
body, including its cast and trace operations, remains on the original parent.

Frozen observers distinguish lexical default calls from receiver overrides and
check null/aliased/fresh results, invalid cast results, receiver nulls, exception
identity and partial effects. Source and SDK-trace profiles compile every emitted
Java unit and compare all definitions, supported metadata and Exceptions, with
exact reported helper/synthetic, SourceFile and Java 9 version differences.
